visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Table Entries in the Wrong Order
visualizerParams.problemDescription: subtract should print 8 and multiply 48, but the two results are swapped.

solution.explanation: Two parallel arrays only work when their entries line up. The second name is subtract but the second function is multiply, so the labels and results no longer match. Keep the tables in the same order, or put the name and function in one struct.
